method: Four full-size screenshots plus twelve sampled recording frames from approximately seconds 6–39 at three-second intervals; not frame-by-frame review of the whole recording
observations: The native editor ends with the two editable note bodies; no extra root typing paragraph appears below them.
Actual Enter/typing creates continuation prose before the note section; the saved and restarted reader retains that order.
Context actions still distinguish common and destructive operations; the unused mobile label wraps above its body.
Sampled frames include loading and modal transitions; settled dialog accessibility checks are separate evidence.
